$about: The one source for LOG's design values. `npm run tokens` (also run before every build) writes src/styles/tokens.gen.css, src/tokens/tokens.js and the colors block of DESIGN.md. Edit values here, never in the generated files. Keys are the CSS custom property names without the leading --.

night.note: asphalt at night: the brand dark. The map, the control company, the footer, headlines on paper

night-deep.note: behind the page: under the map and the book

night-rule-soft.note: rule-soft inside night worlds (the token swap in pages.css)

paper.note: road paper: the day ground of reading pages

rule.note: a line on paper: fields, tables, numbering

rule-soft.note: a soft line: separators inside a list

works.note: LOG orange, from the brand book: the one thing that matters now. Never text on paper (2.0:1); night on it 7.7:1

works-light.note: a second tag, bars in a chart. Never text on paper

works-deep.note: orange that has to read as small text on paper (4.7:1)

sign-ink.note: text on orange: always dark, never white

logo-grey.note: the grey half of the logo, read from the v3 book's logo image until LOG sends the master

logo-orange-deep.note: the dark end of the logo's orange gradient; the light end is --works

font-headline.note: headlines: Ploni Tzar Bold, two to four words, closed by a period

font-figure.note: big numbers, numbering and quotes: Ploni Light

fs-h3.note: 32 → 51: destination rows, lead cards, step titles

fs-mega.note: the footer's last legend, the one exception

r-frame.note: the frame around the home map

frame.note: the home map's inset from the window
